requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area.
Energy class D or better, translated to all classes from A1 to D. Green-space proximity and the 600 sqm / 45-person capacity are outside the available energy columns and are not filtered here.
User wants the building located near green spaces. Using the expression of proximity 'near', the threshold is set to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600 m², energy_class A1–D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance ascending. The 45-person capacity has no matching column in the schema or filterable metadata, so it is not applied.
